title: Define Drizzle ORM Schemas for Chat
description: Create new Drizzle ORM schema definitions for chat conversations and messages, associating them with users.
details:
- Add new schema files (e.g., lib/db/schema/chat.ts) defining 'conversations' and 'messages' tables.
- 'conversations' should have a foreign key to the user and metadata fields (e.g., title, created_at).
- 'messages' should have a foreign key to a conversation, sender type (user/ai), content, and timestamp.
- Update the main schema index to include these tables.
- Write and run a migration to apply these changes to the database.
test_strategy:
- Write unit tests for schema validation (using Drizzle's type checks).
- Run migration and verify tables are created in the database.
- Manually insert and query records to ensure relationships are enforced.

title: Implement AI Chat API Route
description: Develop the backend API route at /app/api/chat/route.ts to handle chat requests, stream AI responses, and persist messages.
details:
- Create a POST handler that:
  - Validates user session (using Better Auth).
  - Validates input with Zod (message, conversation ID).
  - Uses @ai-sdk to send the prompt to the AI model and stream the response.
  - After streaming, saves both user and AI messages to the database, linked to the correct conversation and user.
- Ensure the route is protected and returns appropriate errors for unauthenticated requests.
test_strategy:
- Write unit tests for session validation, input validation, and error handling.
- Mock @ai-sdk calls to test streaming and response structure.
- Verify messages are persisted in the database after a chat exchange.

title: Create Chat Page with assistant-ui Integration
description: Build the /app/chat/page.tsx client component using assistant-ui and connect it to the backend API.
details:
- Create a new page at /app/chat/page.tsx marked with 'use client'.
- Use the useChat hook from @ai-sdk/react to manage chat state and API communication.
- Render the conversation using assistant-ui components (e.g., <Thread />).
- Handle loading, error, and streaming states for a responsive UX.
- Ensure only authenticated users can access the page (redirect or show error otherwise).
test_strategy:
- Write component tests for input, message rendering, and error states.
- Manually test sending/receiving messages and streaming behavior.
- Verify authentication protection by attempting access when logged out.

title: Add Chat Navigation to Dashboard Sidebar
description: Update the dashboard sidebar navigation to include a link to the new Chat feature.
details:
- Modify components/ui/sidebar.tsx (or equivalent) to add a 'Chat' link pointing to /chat.
- Ensure the link is styled consistently with other navigation items (using shadcn/ui components).
- Optionally, highlight the active route when on the chat page.
test_strategy:
- Write a unit test to verify the presence and correct routing of the Chat link.
- Manually test navigation from dashboard to chat and back.

title: Persist and Retrieve Chat History
description: Implement logic to load and display previous chat conversations and messages for authenticated users.
details:
- On page load, fetch the user's existing conversations and messages from the database.
- Display a list of conversations for selection (optional for MVP), or auto-load the latest conversation.
- When a conversation is selected, load its message history into the assistant-ui thread.
- Ensure new messages are appended in real time as they are sent/received.
test_strategy:
- Write integration tests to verify chat history loads correctly for different users.
- Manually test switching between conversations and message persistence after reload.
